Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1409
Claimant:
Michelle Nicholson
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
March 10, 2024
Claimant reported a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road and said the other vehicle drifted into their
lane. Claimant states a wrist fracture resulted and is not represented by an attorney.
April 5, 2024
Reviewed the police report, which places the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of the collision. The responding
officer's notes match the described impact point.
May 18, 2024
Photos of the claimant's vehicle show side damage consistent with the reported contact. The other driver gave a
statement that agrees with the claimant's version of the lane change.
July 2, 2024
Two independent witnesses at the scene described the sideswipe the same way the claimant did. Claimant has
repeated the same account in every conversation so far.
July 20, 2024
Confirmed the driver lsited on the policy is the person who was operating the vehicle. No prior damage to the vehicle
is on file, although a neighbor believes the car had been hit some weeks before the reported date. Following up on
that statement.
July 24, 2024
Medical records show a wrist fracture with treatment that followed a usual course and tapered as the claimant
improved. No prior injury to the same area appears in the history provided. Causal link to this collision is still under
review.
October 9, 2024
Repair estimate lines up with the damage pattern shown in the photos and the reported impact. Neighbor follow-up is
pending to clarify the timing of the earlier damage they described.
October 27, 2024
File remains open. Causation of the wrist injury is not yet confirmed. Next step is to obtain the treating provider's
opinion on whether the fracture is consistent with this collision.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
